verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Claude can generate Excel spreadsheets, PowerPoint presentations, Word documents, and PDFs from natural-language prompts, ready to download and use immediately. They also cover reports with charts and presentations built from your documents, with artifacts and Cowork adding formatted documents and other content. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of iterative, multi-turn editing of an existing file (only implied by the 'create and edit files' article title), and independent or hands-on corroboration of file creation and export quality.
